# Pinnacle Counseling Group

> Pinnacle Counseling Group is a Sacramento, California psychotherapy practice operated by Wilson Marriage and Family Therapist Corporation (Group NPI 1053267906) and founded by Enid Wilson, LMFT (#149114, NPI 1508588831). The corporation was filed in early 2026. Pinnacle specializes in high-functioning anxiety, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) with Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP), eating disorders, modern relational therapy, attachment-based work, and outpatient substance use and compulsive-pattern therapy for adults. The practice is LGBTQ-affirming, multicultural-attuned, veteran-friendly, and non-pathologizing. Services include individual therapy, couples counseling, children and teens, organizational consulting, and clinical supervision for California associate clinicians.

## Specialties

- High-functioning anxiety
- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) for OCD
- Eating disorders
- Substance use and compulsive patterns (outpatient, for adults — not a detox, IOP, or residential program)
- Modern relational therapy
- Attachment-based therapy
- Couples therapy
- Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT)
- Trauma-informed care
- LGBTQ-affirming therapy
- Multicultural-attuned therapy
- Veteran-friendly mental health care
- Non-pathologizing, whole-person care

## Practice approach

Non-pathologizing and whole-person. Pinnacle rejects one-size-fits-all treatment in favor of plans tailored to the individual. Care is delivered with intentional hospitality — the experience clients expect from their other professional relationships.

## About

- [About the practice](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/about.html): Founder story, clinical approach, values, and Sacramento community focus.
- [Providers](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/providers.html): Bios, licenses, and specialties for every clinician.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/services.html)
- [Individual therapy](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/individual-therapy.html): Fifty-minute sessions for adults — high-functioning anxiety, OCD with ERP, eating disorders, substance use and compulsive patterns (outpatient), attachment-based and modern relational work.
- [Couples counseling](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/couples-counseling.html): Fifty- to seventy-five-minute sessions in modern relational and attachment-based traditions including EFT.
- [Children & teens](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/children-and-teens.html): Attachment-based, developmentally attuned sessions with parent collateral time.
- [Organizational consulting](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/organizational-consulting.html): Workplace mental health consulting for leaders and teams.

## Specialty focus areas

Dedicated, research-cited pages for specific clinical specialties. Each is written for a sophisticated readership and cites peer-reviewed research.

- [Motherhood at every stage](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/motherhood.html): Matrescence-informed therapy for mothers — postpartum through the identity shifts of later motherhood.
- [Fertility, loss & reproductive mental health](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/infertility.html): Individual and couples therapy for fertility struggles, pregnancy loss, and reproductive grief.
- [Adoption-competent therapy](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/adoption.html): For adult adoptees, adoptive parents, and adoptive families — grounded in current attachment research.
- [Multicultural couples and families](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/multicultural-families.html): Culturally attuned therapy for intercultural partnerships and families building a third culture.
- [Veterans and military families](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/veterans-military-families.html): Family-systems care for veterans, active-duty service members, and their families.
- [Play therapy for children](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/play-therapy.html): Evidence-based play therapy for children navigating anxiety, trauma, grief, and family transitions.

## Locations & logistics

- [Rates & insurance](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/rates.html): Licensed clinicians $200–225/session, associate clinicians $140–160/session. Some PPO plans accepted; superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.
- [FAQ](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/faq.html): Common questions about getting started, scheduling, telehealth, insurance, and what to expect.
- [Contact](https://pinnaclecounselinggroup.com/contact.html): Telephone (916) 990-2326 / Info@PinnacleCounselingGroup.com.
- Sacramento office (Campus Commons): 2335 American River Drive, Suite 305, Sacramento, CA 95825. Operational now.
- Gold River office: 11201 Gold Express Drive, Suite 200, Gold River, CA 95670. Opens approximately October 1, 2026.
- Telehealth: throughout the state of California.
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–8pm, Sat–Sun 9am–4pm.

## Service area

In-person therapy in Sacramento and Gold River. Telehealth statewide in California, with particular focus on: Sacramento, Carmichael, Granite Bay, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, Roseville, and Loomis.

## Crisis support

This website does not provide crisis services. If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.
